notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature that can be cast using at most {G} and one colored mana.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
